title: Pilot Statewide Plastics Monitoring Program
abstract: Up to $2,500,000 was approved to develop and implement a pilot statewide microplastics monitoring program, guided by the Statewide Plastics Monitoring Strategy and Planning Framework.
curation_note: Verified in the June 16 2026 Council meeting summary text: 'Up to $2,500,000 was approved'. Amount is an up-to cap; recipient is not named in the summary. Derived columns left blank and computed on ingest.
